stops.note: named for the raffia palm whose leaf fibers were stripped for weaving

stops.note: adopted by French botanists cataloguing Madagascar's flora
settled into English for the woven fiber itself
stops.meaning: soft palm fiber used for weaving and tying

current_meaning: A fiber from the leaves of the raffia palm, used for weaving baskets, mats, and garden ties.
